from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
output = root / '.audit/full-regression-3b65d5d8'
state = json.loads((output / 'result.json').read_text())
assert state['exit'] == 0 and state['source_unchanged'], state
manifest = json.loads((output / 'source-manifest.json').read_text())
current = {path.relative_to(root).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
           for folder in ('frontengine', 'tests') for path in (root / folder).rglob('*.py')}
assert current == manifest, 'Tested source set or content changed'
assert len(current) == state['source_count'] == 748
suite = ET.parse(output / 'junit.xml').getroot().find('testsuite')
cases = suite.findall('testcase')
failures = [case.attrib for case in cases if case.find('failure') is not None or case.find('error') is not None]
skipped = [{'module': case.get('classname'), 'name': case.get('name'),
            'reason': case.find('skipped').get('message')}
           for case in cases if case.find('skipped') is not None]
assert not failures, failures
assert len(cases) == int(suite.get('tests')) == 3170
assert len(skipped) == int(suite.get('skipped')) == 3
assert {(case['module'], case['name'], case['reason']) for case in skipped} == {
    ('tests.unit_test.test_default_storage_binding',
     'test_forked_empty_default_registry_rejects_inherited_locked_mutex', 'Requires POSIX fork'),
    ('tests.unit_test.test_remote_tls',
     'test_private_key_and_directory_are_owner_only', 'POSIX permission semantics'),
    ('tests.unit_test.test_storage_session',
     'test_forked_child_cannot_use_or_release_parent_owner', 'Requires POSIX fork'),
}
assert int(suite.get('failures')) == int(suite.get('errors')) == 0
requirements = {
    'blocked_work_reason_and_recovery': ('test_blocked_work_reason_is_visible_until_work_resumes', 3),
    'visible_focus': ('test_item_view_focus_is_visible_without_selection_or_resizing', 12),
    'accessible_name': ('test_work_list_accessible_name_follows_language', 1),
    'exact_page_search': ('test_exact_page_name_enter_opens_matching_page', 2),
    'plugin_search_and_collision': ('test_registered_plugin_page_is_searchable_without_recreating_it', 2),
}
verified = {}
for label, (prefix, count) in requirements.items():
    selected = [case for case in cases if case.get('name', '').startswith(prefix)]
    assert len(selected) == count, (label, len(selected), count)
    assert all(case.find('skipped') is None for case in selected), label
    verified[label] = [case.get('name') for case in selected]
assert {name.rsplit('[', 1)[1].rstrip(']') for name in verified['blocked_work_reason_and_recovery']} == {'waiting_materials', 'no_station', 'station_busy'}
assert any('[tab_text_text]' in name for name in verified['plugin_search_and_collision'])
assert any('[Example clock]' in name for name in verified['plugin_search_and_collision'])
log = (output / 'pytest.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
summary = re.search(r'3167 passed, 3 skipped in ([\d.]+)s', log)
assert summary, 'Expected terminal pytest summary missing'
diagnostics = [line for line in log.splitlines() if any(marker in line for marker in ('Timeout (', 'FAILED ', 'ERROR '))]
report = {
    **state,
    'product_test_commit': '3b65d5d8',
    'total': len(cases),
    'passed': len(cases) - len(skipped),
    'failed': 0,
    'skipped': skipped,
    'junit_suite_seconds': suite.get('time'),
    'pytest_reported_seconds': float(summary.group(1)),
    'required_cases': verified,
    'diagnostic_markers': diagnostics,
    'evidence_sha256': {name: hashlib.sha256((output / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                        for name in ('pytest.log', 'junit.xml', 'source-manifest.json', 'result.json')},
    'limits': ['Windows offscreen Qt suite; no native input, hardware or independent-review acceptance.',
               'Documentation-only commits after the source baseline are not product changes.',
               'Three expected POSIX-only cases were skipped; names and reasons were verified.'],
}
assert not any(marker.startswith(('FAILED ', 'ERROR ')) for marker in diagnostics), diagnostics
(root / '.audit/full-regression-3b65d5d8-verified.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'passed': report['passed'], 'skipped': len(skipped), 'verified_cases': verified}))
